id: a1f4c2e0-1b23-4c56-9a8d-7e2f3b4c5d61
status: experimental
description: Detects the Oracle EBS middle-tier (WebLogic/Java or Oracle HTTP Server) spawning an OS shell or download utility, indicative of post-exploitation of the unauthenticated File Transmission RCE CVE-2026-46817.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-oracle-e-business-suite-flaw-now-exploited-in-attacks/
  - https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cspumay2026.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/java'
      - '/httpd'
      - '/apache2'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\beasvc.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/ksh'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
level: high
2496.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("java","java.exe","httpd","httpd.exe","apache2","beasvc.exe","weblogic.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","ksh","python","python3","perl","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh","curl","wget","whoami","id","uname")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2496.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\java.exe OR *\Java.exe OR *\httpd.exe OR *\beasvc.exe OR *\weblogic.exe) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\wget.exe OR *\whoami.exe)
2496.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(java|httpd|apache2|beasvc|weblogic)(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(\/(sh|bash|dash|ksh|python3?|perl|whoami|id|uname|curl|wget)$)|(\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|curl|wget|whoami)\.exe$)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2497.def:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("pubstorm.com","pubstorm.net")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
2497.sent:
ImDnsActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where DnsQuery has_any ("pubstorm.com","pubstorm.net")
| project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, DnsQuery, DnsResponseName, DnsResponseCodeName

2497.sigma:
title: DNS Query to Clop EBS Extortion Domain (pubstorm)
id: b2e5d3f1-2c34-4d67-ab9e-8f3a4c5d6e72
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS resolution of pubstorm.com / pubstorm.net, the CL0P data-leak/extortion contact infrastructure associated with Oracle E-Business Suite exploitation.
references:
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/oracle-ebusiness-suite-zero-day-exploitation
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-oracle-e-business-suite-flaw-now-exploited-in-attacks/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/29
tags:
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.t1657
logsource:
  category: dns
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'pubstorm.com'
      - 'pubstorm.net'
  condition: selection
level: high
2497.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS where (DNS.query="pubstorm.com" OR DNS.query="*.pubstorm.com" OR DNS.query="pubstorm.net" OR DNS.query="*.pubstorm.net") by DNS.src DNS.query DNS.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2497.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/pubstorm\.(com|net)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, DomainName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

2498.def:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where SenderFromDomain in~ ("pubstorm.com","pubstorm.net") or SenderMailFromDomain in~ ("pubstorm.com","pubstorm.net")
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, SenderMailFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation, NetworkMessageId
| order by Timestamp desc
2498.sent:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
| where tolower(P2Sender) has_any ("pubstorm.com","pubstorm.net") or tolower(Sender) has_any ("pubstorm.com","pubstorm.net")
| project TimeGenerated, Operation, Sender, P2Sender, Recipients, Subject, MailboxOwnerUPN
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2498.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Email.All_Email where (All_Email.src_user="*@pubstorm.com" OR All_Email.src_user="*@pubstorm.net") by All_Email.src_user All_Email.recipient All_Email.subject | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Email)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

2499.def:
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where CveId == "CVE-2026-46817"
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, IsInternetFacing, PublicIP) by DeviceId) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate, IsInternetFacing, PublicIP
| order by IsInternetFacing desc
2499.sent:
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where CveId == "CVE-2026-46817"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2499.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Vulnerabilities.Vulnerabilities where (Vulnerabilities.signature="CVE-2026-46817" OR Vulnerabilities.cve="CVE-2026-46817") by Vulnerabilities.dest Vulnerabilities.signature Vulnerabilities.severity | `drop_dm_object_name(Vulnerabilities)`
